type: u32 0x01xxxxxx per object header (+8) and per embedded sub-object
structure: Object ids are relocated by a constant at load
meaning: All 38 584 id words of the tutorial become id + 0x101C3408 at load (0x01011102 -> 0x111D450A). Ids are therefore relative handles inside one file, unique within it; a clone needs fresh ids (max+1 ...) rather than a copy of the source id. Heap gameplay objects carry ids of another range (0x12FDxxxx).
